name: letter-select
prompt: A short soft tap of a small wooden letter tile being picked up, gentle warm click, no echo

name: letter-deselect
prompt: A quiet dull wooden tile being set back down, softer and lower than a pickup tap

name: word-rejected
prompt: A dull rubbery thud followed by a short low descending buzz, like a wrong answer on a game show, muted and not harsh

name: bonus-word
prompt: Two bright sparkling chime notes rising quickly, like a small bell sprinkled with fairy dust

name: word-planted
prompt: A soft rustle of soil and leaves followed by a cheerful three-note glockenspiel motif, like a flower sprouting in a garden

name: full-wheel
prompt: A triumphant four-note brass and bell flourish rising to a bright held note, short celebratory fanfare

name: wheel-shuffle
prompt: A handful of small wooden letter tiles being rattled and shuffled together in a cupped hand

name: hint-reveal
prompt: A soft magical shimmer, like a tiny glissando of glass bells with a gentle sparkle tail

name: move-undo
prompt: A quick reversed whoosh, like a page being flipped backward or tape rewinding for half a second

name: grove-complete
prompt: A joyful garden celebration fanfare: rising marimba and bell melody ending on a warm major chord with a soft bird chirp

name: round-failed
prompt: Three soft descending muted marimba notes, gentle and sympathetic disappointment, like a small sigh

name: game-pause
prompt: A single soft muted pluck of a nylon guitar string, calm and neutral

name: game-resume
prompt: A single soft pluck of a nylon guitar string with a slightly rising pitch, welcoming and light

name: ui-click
prompt: A very short clean interface button click, like a light plastic switch being pressed

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: A bright three-note medal-unlock chime with a shimmering sustain, like a small trophy bell being rung
